hooks.name: sa-backpressure
hooks.description: Sabiá: after each spec task (Start task / Run all tasks), builds and runs the tests with the commands from sabia.md, writing the output to stderr. On failure: in the IDE, stderr goes to the agent; in CLI V3, it becomes a warning. It does not block the next task — the gate is the backpressure the agent itself runs on every task.
